title: Coast Guard rescues mariner from capsized vessel near Columbia River Bar
description: U.S. Coast Guard Petty Officer 3rd Class Branch Walton, a rescue swimmer assigned to Coast Guard Air Station North Bend, Oregon, rescues a mariner after his vessel capsizes near Astoria, Oregon, Feb. 3, 2023. An MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew with the Advanced Helicopter Rescue School at Coast Guard Aviation Training Center Mobile, Alabama, and three motor life boat crews with the Coast Guard National Motor Lifeboat School and Coast Guard Station Cape Disappointment in Ilwaco, Washington, participated in the rescue. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Kyle Turcotte)
